gloss: to happen to see, to catch sight of

definitions.gloss: to happen to see, to catch sight of
definitions.explanation: To see someone or something by chance, without intending to.
To observe or notice something while passing by or looking around.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}で{彼|かれ}を{見掛|みか}けた。
examples.english: I happened to see him at the station.

examples.japanese: この{辺|あた}りで{見掛|みか}けない{顔|かお}だね。
examples.english: You're a face I don't see around here.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}よく{見掛|みか}ける{広告|こうこく}だ。
examples.english: It's an advertisement I see often lately.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}で{彼女|かのじょ}を{見掛|みか}けた。
examples.english: I happened to see her on the train.

examples.japanese: {珍|めずら}しい{鳥|とり}を{見掛|みか}けた。
{彼|かれ}を{最近|さいきん}{見掛|みか}けない。
examples.english: I haven't seen him around lately.

examples.japanese: その{商品|しょうひん}はどこでも{見掛|みか}ける。
{公園|こうえん}で{散歩|さんぽ}している{人|ひと}を{見掛|みか}けた。
examples.english: I happened to see someone taking a walk in the park.

examples.japanese: よく{見掛|みか}ける{顔|かお}だ。
{昨日|きのう}{先生|せんせい}を{駅前|えきまえ}で{見掛|みか}けた。
examples.english: I happened to see my teacher in front of the station yesterday.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

TRANSITIVE PAIR: None commonly used

ASPECT:
- {見掛|みか}ける: to catch sight of (punctual)
- {見掛|みか}けている: not typically used in progressive

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{見掛|みか}ける (to catch sight of ~)
- {見掛|みか}けによらず (contrary to appearances)
- {見掛|みか}け{倒|だお}し (all show and no substance)

RELATED:
- {見|み}かけ (noun): appearance, looks
